heads.measurableAtFramesReason: the head's own guard is also the point at which it measures what it claims
heads.samplingAssumption: One frame per tick, evenly spaced. Sign of net change over the whole window.
heads.windowSemantics: LAST_MINUS_FIRST over the full window; no sub-window.
heads.missingHistoryBehaviour: Returns null (no semantic output) below three usable samples.

heads.measurableAtFramesReason: the head's own guard is also the point at which it measures what it claims
heads.samplingAssumption: Adjacent frames are one tick apart, so a difference is a rate.
heads.windowSemantics: RMS of all first differences over the window.

heads.measurableAtFramesReason: the head's own guard is also the point at which it measures what it claims
heads.temporalField: channel level and recent slope against a DECLARED threshold
heads.samplingAssumption: Recent slope extrapolates linearly in ticks.
heads.windowSemantics: Slope of the last five samples; ticks-to-cross is a division.
heads.missingHistoryBehaviour: MISSING_THRESHOLD_OR_HISTORY. Hard-suppressed when the scenario declares no threshold semantics, regardless of history length.
heads.source: stage2i2: TIME_TO_THRESHOLD_HEAD requires channelSemantics.threshold + polarity and values.length >= 4

heads.measurableAtFramesReason: the head's own guard is also the point at which it measures what it claims
heads.temporalField: sample count, channel coverage, full vs recent slope agreement, volatility
heads.samplingAssumption: Coverage is measured against the number of frames offered, so a partially populated channel is visible as such.
heads.windowSemantics: Gate: >= 5 samples AND coverage >= 0.8 AND no full/recent slope conflict AND volatility < 0.14.
heads.missingHistoryBehaviour: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. This head IS the abstention mechanism.

heads.measurableAtFramesReason: the head's own guard is also the point at which it measures what it claims
heads.temporalField: signs of first differences, longest opposing run, full vs recent slope
heads.samplingAssumption: A run of same-signed differences is a sustained direction; interruptions are bounded, not fatal.
heads.windowSemantics: Dominant sign share over all differences, tolerant of bounded interruption.
heads.missingHistoryBehaviour: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with SHORT_OR_MISSING_HISTORY; also requires coverage >= 0.8.

heads.measurableAtFramesReason: the head's own guard is also the point at which it measures what it claims
heads.samplingAssumption: The window splits into a prior stretch and a tail of about four ticks.
heads.windowSemantics: cut = max(3, n - 4); prior slope over [0, cut), tail slope over [cut - 1, n). Both must be materially non-flat.

heads.measurableAtFramesReason: The head will search a lag of 8 only once floor(n/2) >= 8, i.e. n >= 16, and a lag-8 correlation on 16 points rests on 8 pairs. At n >= 18 the deepest lag it can select is supported by at least ten pairs.
heads.samplingAssumption: A period is a whole number of ticks; a lag of L needs n - L paired points to be worth anything.
heads.windowSemantics: Best correlation over lags 2..min(8, floor(n/2)); needs amplitude >= 0.08 as well.
heads.source: stage2i2: CYCLE_HEAD values.length < 8 => SHORT_HISTORY; lag <= min(8, floor(n/2))

heads.measurableAtFramesReason: The guard admits the head at n = 18, but window = floor(n/3) is only 6 there: the head answers on windows narrower than the 8 it is built for. floor(n/3) reaches 8 at n = 24, which is the first length at which the head compares two full, disjoint eight-sample windows.
heads.temporalField: level, slope, volatility and cycle statistics of a prior window vs a recent window
heads.samplingAssumption: The two windows describe different stretches of the same process, so they must not overlap.
heads.windowSemantics: window = min(8, floor(n/3)); prior = first `window` samples, recent = last `window` samples.
heads.missingHistoryBehaviour: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with SHORT_OR_MISSING_HISTORY; also requires coverage >= 0.8.
heads.source: stage2i3-oracle-head-remediation.js: values.length < 18 || coverage < .8; window = min(8, floor(values.length / 3))

chosenBecause: The binding head is regimeChange. Its guard opens at 18 frames, so a warm-up of 17 ticks would clear every documented minimum — and would be exactly the mistake the stage forbids, because at 18 frames the head compares six-sample windows instead of the eight-sample windows it is built around. floor(n/3) reaches 8 at n = 24. The warm-up therefore targets 24 observed frames, which 24 ticks deliver on top of the tick-zero frame.

channelVocabularyDefect.finding: The eight-head assembly reads frame.channels.alpha and nothing else. Forge declares its channel as `primary`, so every head computed over an empty series, reported coverage zero and abstained — at any history length. Warm-up alone would not have reached them.
